model.name: R19.32: Shared room link loads the app and join flow, never the offline page.
model.description: BUG: opening a shared room link (/app?join=<roomUuid>) in a browser lands on the 'RawBin — Offline' page instead of loading the app and triggering the join flow. Sharing (sending the link) works, but the receiving browser shows the offline fallback. FIX: the /app?join=<roomUuid> route MUST be served by the service worker as the app shell (not the offline page), the app MUST parse the ?join= query parameter on load, and MUST initiate the join/apply flow for the referenced room. The SW STATIC_SHELL must include /app or the SPA entry that handles this route.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "sharing seems broken… sending worked, but the url in a browser was ending on the offline page on that url."
model.crossRefNote: R19.5 (by-invite Apply button + invite-request message) and R19.6 (public rooms join button) define the join/apply flow that this shared link must trigger. The offline-page bug is likely a SW routing gap: /app?join=... not matched by STATIC_SHELL or fetch handler.
